verdict.rationale: The IRS's own pages document online completion of a founder's core transactions: the EIN online assistant for applying, Direct Pay and EFTPS for paying, the IRIS Taxpayer Portal for e-filing information returns, and mobile-friendly signed forms (including the Form 15620 83(b) election) through Online Account. Missing for 10: the EIN tool only runs during published hours with a 15-minute inactivity timeout and a one-EIN-per-day limit, online signed forms require ID.me identity proofing, the payment pages are documented only thinly, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of a completed transaction.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
